results.name: inquiry_cases
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE inquiry_cases (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  goal TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'resolved', 'abandoned')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),
  resolved_at TEXT
, stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'concept' CHECK (stage IN ('concept', 'plan', 'implementation', 'trial')))

results.name: inquiry_entries
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE inquiry_entries (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  case_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiry_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  clue TEXT NOT NULL,
  asked_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  agent TEXT NOT NULL,
  ask_id TEXT,
  question TEXT NOT NULL,
  answer TEXT,
  info TEXT,
  progress TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'sent', 'answered', 'failed', 'withdrawn')),
  error TEXT,
  duration_seconds INTEGER,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')), avoidable_by_knowledge_id TEXT REFERENCES inquiry_knowledge(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, routing_basis TEXT CHECK (routing_basis IN ('measured', 'access', 'declared', 'inferred', 'none')), routing_asset_kind TEXT,
  UNIQUE (case_id, seq)
)

results.name: inquiry_keys
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE inquiry_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  case_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiry_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('known', 'unknown', 'pitfall')),
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed')),
  blocking INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (blocking IN (0, 1)),
  mutating INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (mutating IN (0, 1)),
  depends_on_key_id TEXT REFERENCES inquiry_keys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  goal_similarity REAL,
  opened_by_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES inquiry_entries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  closed_by_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES inquiry_entries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')), useful INTEGER CHECK (useful IN (0, 1)), closed_by_knowledge_id TEXT REFERENCES inquiry_knowledge(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, domain TEXT,
  UNIQUE (case_id, kind, text)
)

results.name: inquiry_entry_keys
results.sql:
CREATE TABLE inquiry_entry_keys (
  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiry_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  key_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inquiry_keys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('target', 'obtained')),
  PRIMARY KEY (entry_id, key_id, role)
)
